newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Ortiz to attend APEC meeting.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Ortiz to attend APEC meeting.

text.p: Mexican Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz will take part in the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum on Saturday and Sunday in the Philippines, authorities said on Thursday.

"For Mexico, attending these meetings means... incorporating itself to the international financial evolution...of the countries that have registered the greatest economic growth in the past 20 years," the finance ministry said in a statement.
At the last APEC meeting in November, Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo urged APEC nations to speed up free trade plans.
The APEC groups 18 nations, representing the Pacific Rim plus Canada, Chile, Mexico and the United States.
